4174950.name: Chabad of Venice
4174950.note: No year found (Rabbi Mendel Yiftach, son of Marina del Rey's Rabbi Yiftach-Hashem). The listing number (4174950) is from about late 2018. Its chabad.org listing went up on Oct 30 2018 (chabad.org's own record), so it existed by then. Its domain, chabadvenice.com, was only a page pointing to Chabad of Marina del Rey in every capture from Feb 2011 to Jan 7 2018 (https://web.archive.org/web/20180107063340/http://chabadvenice.com/), so its own Venice site came later; it calls itself a 'Branch of Chabad of Marina Del Rey' (Instagram). Not enough for a year.
